published_claims.text: Workers Paid 计划的用户可使用 Standard 用量模式；Workers Enterprise 账户按其合同规定的用量模式计费。

source_span_bindings.quote: Users on the Workers Paid plan have access to the Standard usage model. Workers Enterprise accounts are billed based on the usage model specified in their contract. To switch to the Standard usage model, contact your Account Manager.

published_claims.text: 启用 Workers Caching 时，由 Worker 缓存提供的请求按与调用 Worker 的请求相同的每请求费率计费，包括对静态资源的请求和 worker-to-worker 调用；仅当 Worker 运行（缓存未命中或绕过）时才计 CPU 时间。

source_span_bindings.quote: 4 When Workers Caching is enabled, requests served from the Worker's cache are billed at the same per-request rate as requests that invoke the Worker.
